person.name: Lydia Clark (Wife of Whittington)
person.notes: [Created by split package 2026-11-17.] Widow of Whittington Clark of Indian River Hundred; received the widow's share ($14.50) in the distribution of his estate, 22 Aug 1837 (Delaware Public Archives 4545-000-009). Not the Lydia Clark born 1834 who married Bowen Harmon.

relationships.evidence_text: Distribution account, estate of Whittington Clark, 22 Aug 1837: Lydia Clark received the widow's share
